resources.string: Doing: full-page rendering and moving color strip
Doing: scrollable long card and simulated timer

Full-page rendering is now the default for particle animations on supported systems. Short and long cards share the same implementation. The long-card test supports vertical scrolling and swiping, with live timer digit transitions. It uses fictional notes and does not start the timer service. Check both the Close button and system Back, then scroll the previous page. Select the original implementation above to compare.
